rule: A planar momentum-twistor pole <i i+1 j j+1>=0 maps to the dual-coordinate interval x_{i+1,j+1}^2=0, up to nonzero projective normalization.

source.claim: The six-term identity removes unphysical poles; the nine physical poles are s12,s23,s34,s45,s56,s61,t123,t234,t345, with two-particle poles collinear and three-particle poles parity-invariant.

claim_boundary: The four-bracket-to-dual-distance map uses the standard momentum-twistor incidence convention. The source gives the nine physical poles and their collinear/three-particle distinction; it does not list this exact facet table.
